name: What You Leave Behind
hint: Five takes, and each one only becomes possible because of the one before it. TAKE 1: walk right across plate p1 at x=4..6. It LATCHES — you do not have to stand on it, and it stays on for the rest of the take, which powers lift m1 at x=12..16. Finish the take anywhere. TAKE 2: Echo A trips p1 at about t=0.4s, so m1 is already climbing when you get there; board it at about t=1.1s while the deck is level with the floor and ride from y=19 to y=13, step across the 1-unit gap onto the gantry at x=17..23, and stand on p2 at x=19. p2 reads recordings only, so nothing happens while you personally stand there — that is expected. TAKE 3: Echo B is on p2 now, so door d1 at x=23.5 is open. Ride up, cross the gantry, through the doorway onto the catwalk at x=25..30, and press switch s1 at x=27. It holds for 8 seconds and powers lift m2 at x=31..35, but you are on the wrong floor to use it — this take exists to record the press. TAKE 4: ride m1, cross, pass d1, walk the catwalk, and board m2 as Echo C's switch brings it level with the catwalk at y=13; ride to y=8, step onto the top deck at x=35..40, and stand on p4 at x=35.2. That opens the last door d2 at x=37.6. TAKE 5: every stair is held by someone. Ride, cross, pass, board, ride again, and walk through the final doorway into the exit at x=38.2 — about eleven seconds of climbing over four earlier versions of yourself.

dialogue.text: Four of you holding the building open. None of them will see the top.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: They knew that when they stopped walking.
No. You knew it. They only did what you did.
